title: Invoice status sequence
content: Invoices progress through Received, Confirmed, Authorized, Exported, Paid and Completed. A requested transition must satisfy the preceding status and the required role.
recommended_action: Verify current status, requested transition and user role.

title: Invoice authorization role
content: Invoice authorization requires a Manager or Senior Manager role, an invoice in Confirmed status and an amount within the user's authorization limit.
recommended_action: Check role, authorization limit and invoice status.

title: Batch export prerequisites
content: A batch can be exported only when every invoice in the batch is Authorized and the batch is not frozen.
recommended_action: List invoice statuses and verify the batch freeze flag.

title: Mandatory D2021 envelope
content: A D2021 file starts with exactly one ZHV header and ends with exactly one ZPT trailer. Critical structural errors reject the complete file.
recommended_action: Review the file sequence and resubmit the corrected complete file.

title: D2021 parent-child hierarchy
content: A CCD charge belongs to a preceding BCD invoice. A BCD invoice belongs to a CLO site and at least one MPC meter-point record.
recommended_action: Trace CLO, MPC, BCD and CCD order and locate the missing parent.

title: Confirmed batch cannot be exported
symptom: A confirmed batch does not produce an export file.
possible_causes: Invoices are Confirmed but not Authorized
content: A confirmed batch cannot be exported directly. All invoices must first be Authorized. A frozen batch, incomplete mapping or output access failure can also block export.
recommended_action: Inspect statuses first, then freeze state, mapping and file-system access.

title: D2021 file remains unprocessed
symptom: A D2021 file remains in the input location and no invoices are created.
content: An unprocessed D2021 file may indicate a naming, scheduler, service, access or structural failure.
recommended_action: Check filename, scheduler, service, directory access and structural error logs in that order.

title: Capacity discrepancy report
content: The capacity discrepancy report compares billed capacity with approved reference capacity and displays the financial difference.
recommended_action: Use the report to prioritize high-value capacity differences.

title: Cited evidence requirement
content: Support answers must cite retrieved evidence. When evidence is insufficient the application must refuse unsupported conclusions and request missing details.
recommended_action: Return a grounded answer or a safe evidence-insufficient response.

title: No autonomous production changes
content: The copilot may recommend read-only investigation steps but must not perform production updates or present unapproved data patches as executable actions.
recommended_action: Require human approval and existing change controls.
